verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a step-by-step developer quick start guide that walks through creating and authorizing with a token, then creating tasks via the API. A developer sandbox (a temporary Asana domain with limited users) gives engineers a first-time environment to work in. This is a guided walkthrough for building an app, not a documented first-run walkthrough for setting up an Asana workspace itself. Missing for 10: an in-product first-time workspace setup wizard or onboarding flow, documentation of workspace configuration steps such as teams, projects and members, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.
